mods.title: CHKDS: Iskrinka
mods.description: 2020. The Dark Valley is open again after another emission. The squad of official stalkers sent to study laboratory X-18 vanished without a trace. You are Frolov's assistant, a member of the 'Iskra' research group dispatched by the CHAZ Institute to find out what happened to them and survey the laboratory.
